units: <cite ref="Sukkah 44a:9">Succ. 44ᵃ</cite> <he>ערבה י׳ נביאים</he> the use of the willow-branch (on Hoshanah Rabbah) is an institution of the prophets, opp. <he>מנהג נביאים</he> a custom arisen in the days of the prophets; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 1:5:3">Y. Shebi. I, 33ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>מִיִּ׳ נביאים וכ׳</he> belong to the institutions of the early prophets; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 4:1:2">Y. Succ. IV, beg. 54ᵇ</cite>
